existing_expansions.required: Compose all 11,172 modern Hangul syllables from 360 16x16 components: 20*8 leading, 22*4 medial, 28*4 trailing cells. Choose variant by vowel class, leading consonant and trailing presence; OR exact bitmaps. Component-only read is insufficient. Preserve components for optional component export; arbitrary syllable decomposition is not uniquely invertible and must be reported explicitly.
existing_expansions.oracle: Independent table-driven reference from published Johab 8/4/4 rules, testing each L/V/T combination; no GPL implementation transplantation.
existing_expansions.sample: Original deterministic MIT component rasters exercise all rules; do not copy GPL Hanterm/Unifont components without explicit permitted fixture choice.

existing_expansions.required: Read/write record and resource database envelopes, standard NFNT and extended density resources; preserve native codes, densities and endian variants. GrayFont GrFn/GXYZ grayscale resources are an additional documented font subfamily; published monobit 0.54 contains experimental unregistered grayfont.py, so do not claim its registry validates them.
existing_expansions.oracle: monobit read oracle for registered Palm forms; Palm SDK structures and FontConv/PilRC as external tools for other forms.
existing_expansions.sample: Original NFNT-derived synthetic resources; Alpha-2B.pdb is not accepted as a freely redistributable commercial-use fixture.

existing_expansions.required: Psion/EPOC/Symbian GDR font stores, typefaces/strikes, native indexes, metrics and compressed bitmaps; identify format versions rather than treat extension as a single layout.
existing_expansions.oracle: Symbian fnttran compiler and EKA2L1 gdrdump independent loader; run externally, no GPL/MPL source copying.
existing_expansions.sample: Compile project-authored MIT BDF plus original GD definition through fnttran; do not adopt CEUROPE.GDR without reviewing its separate font rights.

existing_expansions.required: Existing generic/GFX profiles remain. U8g2 needs native compressed glyph streams and Unicode jump tables; LVGL needs lv_font_t/fmt_txt metadata, cmap modes, bit depths, RLE and kerning. NetBSD wsdisplay_font requires native header metadata. U8glib legacy and U8x8 tile arrays are distinct documented profiles, not automatically covered by generic C. LVGL binary tables are the same family in another explicit container profile.
existing_expansions.oracle: U8g2 bdfconv/runtime, lv_font_conv/LVGL runtime, monobit netbsd, U8glib/U8x8 runtime.
existing_expansions.sample: Original MIT glyphs passed to native generator; Spleen/Gallant kernel C fonts have BSD notices. Individual embedded font artwork licenses still apply.

existing_expansions.required: Add filename-indexed one-glyph-per-image directory read/write using bounded resource and output bundles. Existing atlas mapping is a different representation.
existing_expansions.sample: Public-domain 4x6.imageset files or original MIT PNG glyphs.

existing_expansions.required: Add BinHex 4.0 outer fork envelope; fbit/HFNT/Lisa use separate wire-family entries.
existing_expansions.oracle: monobit decoder and an independently authored CRC/envelope assembler
existing_expansions.sample: Public-domain 4x6.hqx derivation; check fork payload provenance separately.

existing_expansions.required: Add BinSCII transport wrapper around IIgs font data, bounded checksum and segment handling.
existing_expansions.sample: Original MIT IIgs font encoded by independent envelope assembler.

existing_expansions.required: Add Jam3-style BMFont JSON descriptors supported by monobit; reuse bounded PNG page resolution, native glyph metrics and kerning. Existing text/XML/binary-v3 support does not include JSON.
existing_expansions.oracle: monobit bmfont JSON input/output plus Jam3 reader
existing_expansions.sample: Public-domain 6x13.bmf/6x13-json.fnt and its pages, with upstream provenance; or generate project-original glyphs through monobit.

existing_expansions.required: Add explicit layout controls where current RawLayout cannot express monobit raw layouts: glyphs arranged side-by-side in a strike (Harlekin III 4096x8, 512 cells), bit-aligned packing and column-major byte order. Preserve existing byte-aligned contiguous-cell presets. Native raw equivalence requires matching geometry, not merely accepting bytes.

complexity_scale.S: one compact bounded layout or simple text grammar
complexity_scale.M: multiple tables, variants, sidecars, or reversible raster projection
complexity_scale.L: nested collections, compression/version/ABI issues or substantial metrics and executable-envelope validation; no duration inferred

completion_rule: All feasible new families require native readers and writers, per-glyph loss reports, appropriate external pixel/metric checks and fuzz coverage. A monobit reader-only entry does not excuse a fontpixel reader-only implementation. No family is deferred merely for lacking a permissively licensed preexisting native sample.

sample_policy.allowed: Project-authored MIT synthetic glyphs; public-domain/OFL/BSD/MIT/Apache source fonts with explicit notices. Downloaded files remain outside repo; implementations must add fetch URLs and SHA-256 to their fixture manifest before relying on them.
not_automatically_allowed: Alpha-2B.pdb and alpha.fnt carry commercial-use conditions.
Monobit MIT code license does not cover all test font artwork.
Free glyphs inside COM loaders do not license executable stubs.
Device ROM extracts and SDK fonts without separate redistribution licenses.
A derivative filename resembling 4x6 is insufficient provenance by itself.
sample_policy.no_native_fixture_rule: No verified ready-made native sample is an evidence gap, not a reason to cancel a feasible codec. Generate original fixtures independently and verify against a separate implementation.

ancillary_nonfonts.name: TFM
ancillary_nonfonts.reason: TeX advance/kerning/design metrics sidecar without glyph rasters; handled by pk/gf/pxl, not an independent bitmap codec.

ancillary_nonfonts.name: AFM/PFM
ancillary_nonfonts.reason: Metric-only files, no native bitmap glyph payload.

ancillary_nonfonts.name: FOND/FONTDIR
ancillary_nonfonts.reason: Family/resource directory accompanying existing NFNT/FON fonts, not a substitute for their glyph payloads.

ancillary_nonfonts.name: X11 fonts.dir/fonts.alias
ancillary_nonfonts.reason: Index and alias databases, not raster font wire formats.

ancillary_nonfonts.name: GD (Symbian font definition)
ancillary_nonfonts.reason: Input to fnttran describing the GDR collection; belongs to gdr interchange/oracle tooling.

ancillary_nonfonts.name: PDF/PS Type 3 executable glyph procedures
ancillary_nonfonts.reason: General page-description programs, not a fixed bitmap font wire schema; image/font extraction requires rendering and is outside this survey of standalone bitmap formats.

ancillary_nonfonts.name: PNG/BMP/GIF/TGA/PBM/PGM
ancillary_nonfonts.reason: Already image payload formats; marker-row SFont/RFont and PILfont are separately inventoried because they define additional glyph/metric semantics.

group_a_order.reason: Eight single-file text/native-header codecs; no compiler, executable stub or new directory enumeration contract.
Increasing complexity: compact fixed layouts, directory bundle support, half-dot projection, container sections, sparse Unicode chunks, executable-loader envelope validation.

implementation_acceptance: Implement native read and native write for every accepted id/variant; monobit writer absence is not a waiver.
Use typed format/variant options and detection by bounded magic/structure before suffix.
Report each unsupported mapping, raster reduction, metric approximation, metadata or non-font section loss; strict mode must prevent output.
Count all nested resources, offsets, compressed sizes, rasters and diagnostic allocations against one ResourceLimits budget.
Compare independent oracle pixels and metrics; self-roundtrip alone is insufficient. Read-only oracles need independently generated fixture bytes as well as oracle decoding of fontpixel output.
Use original/permissively licensed fixtures with fetch URL and SHA-256; do not assume converter code licensing covers glyph artwork or executable loader stubs.
Run reader fuzzing and the parent stage acceptance/performance protocol; this survey intentionally does not run builds or claim measurements.
